p: Newland Avenue is one of Hull's liveliest streets, packed with independent cafés, bars, takeaways and little shops, and busy with students from the nearby University of Hull. This Admiral is a small adults-only slots shop in the middle of it all, so 18+ and nothing for the kids.

The real fun round here is the food and drink. You can do a whole evening along Newland Avenue and neighbouring Princes Avenue without walking far. For something greener, Pearson Park sits just off Princes Avenue, with its Victorian conservatory and lake, and the leafy Avenues area beyond is full of grand old houses and ornate fountains. It's a very different side of Hull to the city centre and the docks.
